from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_FLOOR, ROUND_HALF_UP

# ==========================================
# CONSTANTS SECTION
# ==========================================

# Sec 16(ia) — Standard deduction
STD_DEDUCTION_OLD = Decimal("50000")  # Sec 16(ia) old regime standard deduction limit
STD_DEDUCTION_NEW = Decimal("75000")  # Sec 115BAC new regime standard deduction limit

# Sec 24(b) — Self-occupied house property interest deduction (old regime only)
SOP_INTEREST_LIMIT = Decimal("200000")  # Sec 24(b) max interest deduction for self-occupied property

# Sec 80C, 80CCE — Investment deductions limit (old regime only)
SEC_80C_LIMIT = Decimal("150000")  # Sec 80CCE maximum aggregate deduction under Sec 80C

# Sec 80CCD(1B) — Additional NPS contribution limit (old regime only)
SEC_80CCD_1B_LIMIT = Decimal("50000")  # Sec 80CCD(1B) additional NPS deduction limit

# Sec 80D — Health insurance deduction limits (old regime only)
SEC_80D_SELF_LIMIT = Decimal("25000")  # Sec 80D(i) limit for self/spouse/children (non-senior)
SEC_80D_SELF_SR_LIMIT = Decimal("50000")  # Sec 80D(i) limit for self/spouse/children (senior citizen)
SEC_80D_PARENTS_LIMIT = Decimal("25000")  # Sec 80D(ii) limit for parents (non-senior)
SEC_80D_PARENTS_SR_LIMIT = Decimal("50000")  # Sec 80D(ii) limit for parents (senior citizen)

# First Schedule, Part III, Para A — Old regime income tax slabs: list of (lower, upper_or_None, rate)
OLD_SLABS_UNDER_60 = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("250000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("250000"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]
OLD_SLABS_SENIOR = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("300000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("300000"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]
OLD_SLABS_SUPER_SENIOR = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]

# Sec 115BAC(1A)(ii) — New regime income tax slabs: list of (lower, upper_or_None, rate)
NEW_SLABS = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("300000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("300000"), Decimal("700000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("700000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.10")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("1200000"), Decimal("0.15")),
    (Decimal("1200000"), Decimal("1500000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1500000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]

# Sec 87A — Rebate limits and thresholds
REBATE_LIMIT_OLD = Decimal("500000")  # Sec 87A old regime income threshold for rebate
REBATE_MAX_OLD = Decimal("12500")  # Sec 87A old regime max rebate amount
REBATE_LIMIT_NEW = Decimal("700000")  # Sec 87A new regime income threshold for rebate
REBATE_MAX_NEW = Decimal("25000")  # Sec 87A new regime max rebate amount

# First Schedule — Surcharge thresholds and rates
SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS = [
    (Decimal("5000000"), Decimal("0.10")),
    (Decimal("10000000"), Decimal("0.15")),
    (Decimal("20000000"), Decimal("0.25")),
    (Decimal("50000000"), Decimal("0.37")),
]

# Health and Education Cess rate
CESS_RATE = Decimal("0.04")  # Health and Education Cess rate (4%)


# ==========================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ==========================================

def round_nearest_ten(amount: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    """
    Sec 288A / Sec 288B rounding:
    First drop paise (floor to whole rupees), then round to the nearest multiple of 10
    where a last digit of 5 or more rounds UP.
    """
    whole = amount.quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_FLOOR)
    rem = whole % Decimal("10")
    if rem >= Decimal("5"):
        return whole + (Decimal("10") - rem)
    else:
        return whole - rem


def compute_slab_tax(taxable_income: Decimal, slabs: list[tuple[Decimal, Decimal | None, Decimal]]) -> tuple[Decimal, list[tuple[str, Decimal]]]:
    total_tax = Decimal("0")
    trace_items = []
    for lower, upper, rate in slabs:
        if taxable_income <= lower:
            slab_tax = Decimal("0")
            tax_in_band = Decimal("0")
        elif upper is not None and taxable_income > upper:
            tax_in_band = upper - lower
            slab_tax = tax_in_band * rate
        else:
            tax_in_band = taxable_income - lower
            slab_tax = tax_in_band * rate

        total_tax += slab_tax
        if rate > 0:
            if upper is not None:
                desc = f"Tax at {rate * 100}% on income between {lower} and {upper}"
            else:
                desc = f"Tax at {rate * 100}% on income above {lower}"
            trace_items.append((desc, slab_tax))
    return total_tax, trace_items


def get_surcharge_rate(total_income: Decimal, is_new_regime: bool) -> Decimal:
    rate = Decimal("0")
    for threshold, r in SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS:
        if total_income > threshold:
            rate = r
    if is_new_regime and rate > Decimal("0.25"):
        rate = Decimal("0.25")
    return rate


def calculate_tax_details(taxable_income: Decimal, is_new_regime: bool, age: int) -> tuple[Decimal, Decimal, Decimal, Decimal, list[dict]]:
    # 1. Determine slabs
    if is_new_regime:
        slabs = NEW_SLABS
    else:
        if age >= 80:
            slabs = OLD_SLABS_SUPER_SENIOR
        elif age >= 60:
            slabs = OLD_SLABS_SENIOR
        else:
            slabs = OLD_SLABS_UNDER_60

    slab_tax, slab_traces = compute_slab_tax(taxable_income, slabs)
    tax_trace = []
    for desc, amt in slab_traces:
        tax_trace.append({"kind": "tax", "description": desc, "amount": str(amt), "clause": "First Schedule, Part III, Para A / Sec 115BAC"})

    # 2. Rebate Sec 87A
    rebate = Decimal("0")
    if is_new_regime:
        if taxable_income <= REBATE_LIMIT_NEW:
            rebate = min(slab_tax, REBATE_MAX_NEW)
        elif taxable_income > REBATE_LIMIT_NEW:
            # Marginal relief for new regime Sec 87A
            excess_income = taxable_income - REBATE_LIMIT_NEW
            tax_without_rebate = slab_tax
            if tax_without_rebate > excess_income:
                marginal_rebate = tax_without_rebate - excess_income
                if marginal_rebate > 0:
                    rebate = marginal_rebate
    else:
        if taxable_income <= REBATE_LIMIT_OLD:
            rebate = min(slab_tax, REBATE_MAX_OLD)

    tax_after_rebate = max(Decimal("0"), slab_tax - rebate)
    if rebate > 0:
        tax_trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Rebate under Section 87A",
            "amount": str(-rebate),
            "clause": "Sec 87A"
        })

    # 3. Surcharge & Marginal Relief
    surcharge_rate = get_surcharge_rate(taxable_income, is_new_regime)
    surcharge_amt = tax_after_rebate * surcharge_rate

    if surcharge_amt > 0:
        tax_trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": f"Surcharge at {surcharge_rate * 100}%",
            "amount": str(surcharge_amt),
            "clause": "First Schedule - Surcharge"
        })

        # Surcharge Marginal Relief calculation
        # Find applicable threshold
        applicable_threshold = None
        threshold_rate = None
        for threshold, r in SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS:
            if is_new_regime and r > Decimal("0.25"):
                continue
            if taxable_income > threshold:
                applicable_threshold = threshold
                threshold_rate = r

        if applicable_threshold is not None:
            # Tax + surcharge on threshold income
            t_thresh_slab, _ = compute_slab_tax(applicable_threshold, slabs)
            t_thresh_rebate = Decimal("0")
            if is_new_regime and applicable_threshold <= REBATE_LIMIT_NEW:
                t_thresh_rebate = min(t_thresh_slab, REBATE_MAX_NEW)
            elif not is_new_regime and applicable_threshold <= REBATE_LIMIT_OLD:
                t_thresh_rebate = min(t_thresh_slab, REBATE_MAX_OLD)
            t_thresh_after_rebate = max(Decimal("0"), t_thresh_slab - t_thresh_rebate)
            t_thresh_surcharge = t_thresh_after_rebate * threshold_rate
            total_at_threshold = t_thresh_after_rebate + t_thresh_surcharge

            actual_total_tax_surcharge = tax_after_rebate + surcharge_amt
            excess_income = taxable_income - applicable_threshold
            max_allowed = total_at_threshold + excess_income

            if actual_total_tax_surcharge > max_allowed:
                surcharge_marginal_relief = actual_total_tax_surcharge - max_allowed
                surcharge_amt -= surcharge_marginal_relief
                tax_trace.append({
                    "kind": "tax",
                    "description": "Surcharge marginal relief",
                    "amount": str(-surcharge_marginal_relief),
                    "clause": "First Schedule - Surcharge Marginal Relief"
                })

    tax_after_surcharge = tax_after_rebate + surcharge_amt

    # 4. Cess
    cess_amt = tax_after_surcharge * CESS_RATE
    tax_trace.append({
        "kind": "tax",
        "description": "Health and Education Cess at 4%",
        "amount": str(cess_amt),
        "clause": "Health and Education Cess"
    })

    total_tax_unrounded = tax_after_surcharge + cess_amt
    rounded_tax = round_nearest_ten(total_tax_unrounded)
    tax_adjustment = rounded_tax - total_tax_unrounded

    tax_trace.append({
        "kind": "tax",
        "description": "Rounding adjustment",
        "amount": str(tax_adjustment),
        "clause": "Sec 288B"
    })

    return slab_tax, rebate, surcharge_amt, rounded_tax, tax_trace


# ==========================================
# MAIN COMPUTE FUNCTION
# ==========================================

def compute(inp: dict) -> dict:
    gross_salary = Decimal(str(inp.get("gross_salary", 0)))
    age = int(inp.get("age", 0))
    hra_received = Decimal(str(inp.get("hra_received", 0)))
    basic_plus_da = Decimal(str(inp.get("basic_plus_da", 0)))
    rent_paid = Decimal(str(inp.get("rent_paid", 0)))
    rent_city_is_metro = bool(inp.get("rent_city_is_metro", False))
    home_loan_interest = Decimal(str(inp.get("home_loan_interest", 0)))
    sec_80c = Decimal(str(inp.get("sec_80c", 0)))
    sec_80ccd_1b = Decimal(str(inp.get("sec_80ccd_1b", 0)))
    health_ins_self = Decimal(str(inp.get("health_ins_self", 0)))
    health_ins_parents = Decimal(str(inp.get("health_ins_parents", 0)))
    parents_senior = bool(inp.get("parents_senior", False))

    def compute_regime(is_new: bool) -> tuple[int, int, list[dict]]:
        trace = []
        
        # 1. Salary & Standard Deduction
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Gross salary",
            "amount": str(gross_salary),
            "clause": "Sec 17(1)"
        })

        if is_new:
            std_dedn = min(gross_salary, STD_DEDUCTION_NEW)
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Standard deduction",
                "amount": str(-std_dedn),
                "clause": "Sec 16(ia) proviso (Sec 115BAC)"
            })
            salary_after_std = gross_salary - std_dedn

            # HRA, Chapter VI-A, House property interest are NOT allowed under new regime
            net_salary = salary_after_std
            gti = max(Decimal("0"), net_salary)
            total_income_unrounded = gti
        else:
            std_dedn = min(gross_salary, STD_DEDUCTION_OLD)
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Standard deduction",
                "amount": str(-std_dedn),
                "clause": "Sec 16(ia)"
            })
            salary_after_std = gross_salary - std_dedn

            # HRA Exemption (Sec 10(13A) read with Rule 2A)
            hra_exempt = Decimal("0")
            if hra_received > 0 and rent_paid > 0:
                cond_a = hra_received
                cond_b = max(Decimal("0"), rent_paid - (Decimal("0.10") * basic_plus_da))
                metro_rate = Decimal("0.50") if rent_city_is_metro else Decimal("0.40")
                cond_c = basic_plus_da * metro_rate
                hra_exempt = min(cond_a, cond_b, cond_c)

            if hra_exempt > 0:
                trace.append({
                    "kind": "income",
                    "description": "HRA exemption",
                    "amount": str(-hra_exempt),
                    "clause": "Sec 10(13A) read with Rule 2A"
                })

            taxable_salary = max(Decimal("0"), salary_after_std - hra_exempt)

            # House Property Loss (Sec 24(b) & Sec 71(3A))
            hp_loss = min(home_loan_interest, SOP_INTEREST_LIMIT)
            if hp_loss > 0:
                trace.append({
                    "kind": "income",
                    "description": "Income from house property (loss)",
                    "amount": str(-hp_loss),
                    "clause": "Sec 24(b) and Sec 71(3A)"
                })

            gti = max(Decimal("0"), taxable_salary - hp_loss)

            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Gross total income",
                "amount": str(gti),
                "clause": "Gross total income"
            })

            # Chapter VI-A Deductions
            # Sec 80C limited to 1,50,000 (Sec 80CCE)
            ded_80c = min(sec_80c, SEC_80C_LIMIT)
            if ded_80c > 0:
                trace.append({
                    "kind": "income",
                    "description": "Deduction under Section 80C",
                    "amount": str(-ded_80c),
                    "clause": "Sec 80C read with Sec 80CCE"
                })

            # Sec 80CCD(1B) limited to 50,000
            ded_80ccd_1b = min(sec_80ccd_1b, SEC_80CCD_1B_LIMIT)
            if ded_80ccd_1b > 0:
                trace.append({
                    "kind": "income",
                    "description": "Deduction under Section 80CCD(1B)",
                    "amount": str(-ded_80ccd_1b),
                    "clause": "Sec 80CCD(1B)"
                })

            # Sec 80D Health Insurance
            # Self, spouse, children limit: 50,000 if senior, else 25,000
            # Note: inp doesn't specify if self/spouse is senior, but age is given. If age >= 60, self is senior.
            self_limit = SEC_80D_SELF_SR_LIMIT if age >= 60 else SEC_80D_SELF_LIMIT
            ded_80d_self = min(health_ins_self, self_limit)
            if ded_80d_self > 0:
                trace.append({
                    "kind": "income",
                    "description": "Deduction under Section 80D (self)",
                    "amount": str(-ded_80d_self),
                    "clause": "Sec 80D"
                })

            # Parents limit: 50,000 if parents_senior, else 25,000
            parents_limit = SEC_80D_PARENTS_SR_LIMIT if parents_senior else SEC_80D_PARENTS_LIMIT
            ded_80d_parents = min(health_ins_parents, parents_limit)
            if ded_80d_parents > 0:
                trace.append({
                    "kind": "income",
                    "description": "Deduction under Section 80D (parents)",
                    "amount": str(-ded_80d_parents),
                    "clause": "Sec 80D"
                })

            total_vi_a = ded_80c + ded_80ccd_1b + ded_80d_self + ded_80d_parents

            # Sec 80A(2) Overall cap: Chapter VI-A cannot exceed GTI
            total_vi_a = min(total_vi_a, gti)

            total_income_unrounded = max(Decimal("0"), gti - total_vi_a)

        # Sec 288A — Rounding of total income
        rounded_total_income = round_nearest_ten(total_income_unrounded)
        income_adjustment = rounded_total_income - total_income_unrounded

        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Rounding adjustment",
            "amount": str(income_adjustment),
            "clause": "Sec 288A"
        })

        # Tax calculation
        _, _, _, rounded_tax, tax_trace = calculate_tax_details(rounded_total_income, is_new, age)
        trace.extend(tax_trace)

        return int(rounded_total_income), int(rounded_tax), trace

    old_income, old_tax, old_trace = compute_regime(is_new=False)
    new_income, new_tax, new_trace = compute_regime(is_new=True)

    return {
        "old": {"total_income": old_income, "tax_payable": old_tax, "trace": old_trace},
        "new": {"total_income": new_income, "tax_payable": new_tax, "trace": new_trace},
    }
